description: Monthly recurring revenue. Scope is enforced by `monthly_plan` (billing_interval='month'), `active_simple` (ended_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL on subscriptions), and `not_deleted` on the plan/subscription rows. One-time credits, adjustments and taxes are excluded from MRR.

Total revenue. Scope is enforced by `paid_or_partial` (status IN ('paid','partial')) and `not_deleted` (deleted_at IS NULL) on invoices. Questions that specify a single status ("paid invoices") trigger `paid_invoice` instead of `paid_or_partial`.
Count of day boundaries crossed between two UTC timestamps. A payment timestamped on the same calendar day as issued_at has days_to_pay = 0. "Days to resolve" uses other columns and is NOT this KPI.
A rate as an integer in thousandths, floored. Monetary ratios in this suite are expressed per-mille.

Per-row conversion from source currency to target currency using the greatest rate_date in billing.exchange_rates on or before the anchor date (invoice.issued_at date, payment.paid_at date, or a month's first day for monthly aggregations). FLOOR to integer cents BEFORE aggregation; never sum first and divide. USD-to-USD passes through at 1:1 with no rate lookup. If no exchange_rates row exists for the pair/date, the rate is 1.0 (rate_e8 = 100000000).
